authorization.decision: Rent now, cap $18 (Recommended): rent the $1.90/h 112-core offer now and raise the total cap to $18 (active shutdown $14.90); that offer was taken, so 41396007 at $1.922/h with 64 cores was rented
authorization.scope: host verification, remote financial watchdog and pinned runtime preparation while workstation tests and the stage-A freeze finish; no frozen stage starts before the stage-A freeze is deployed
authorization.stage_a: Stage-A freeze after 315 passing workstation tests, the static and Task-7 forward critic audits and the CPU author-backend preflight (21 charged updates). Sachin authorized the four-4090 rental and the $18 cap; the frozen stages run on instance 57688543.

verification.command: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider experiments/tests/test_dsrl11_*.py experiments/tests/test_dsrl06_*.py experiments/tests/test_dsrl07*.py

final_checkpoint: each condition's batch-B publication (actor version 2), exported before any evaluation episode

learner_defaults.image_transform: RGB uint8 PIL bilinear resize to 64x64; no flip or crop
learner_defaults.action: residual u in [-1, 1]^32; decoder noise epsilon + 0.25 * tile(u, 16)
learner_defaults.sampling_seed_rule: uint32 little-endian first four SHA256 bytes of dsrl06-actor:<rng_seed>:<job_id>, then JAX fold_in(query_index)
learner_defaults.condition_streams: agent RNG PRNGKey(derive_seed('learner-rng', condition)) after the shared seed-11060 initialization; replay default_rng(derive_seed('replay', condition, 'online' or 'bank')); calibration PRNGKey(derive_seed('calibration-actions', condition))
learner_defaults.prior_mixture: prior conditions: 128 uniform bank and 128 uniform online transitions per update, bank rows first; other conditions: 256 uniform online
learner_defaults.update_credit: updates_per_transition per newly appended batch transition; warm-up appends earn no credit

changes_from_task7.action: absolute tiled noise replaced by the native-preserving residual

a1.admission: finite and the stage-C pause rule never fires, for both seeds and both action sets

calibration_gate.quantity: the learner's configured reduction (mean or min) of its ten critic heads, for recorded and actor-sampled actions
calibration_gate.initialization: descriptive baseline, excluded from the pause series
calibration_gate.rationale: a random ensemble scatters single heads (task 7: 26% outside) while its reduced estimate lay inside; decided before any A1 run

geometry.frame: OmniGibson world frame, metres, z up

reach.reason: ManiGuard defines no jar grasp affordance; its own engagement metric measures the eef link to the target root, so reach uses exactly that pair
reach.finger_midpoint_note: The plan's finger midpoint is represented by the pinned Franka eef_link grasp frame, used by the benchmark; finger link positions are recorded for audit only

geometry.closed: native jar_closed proposition, latched at first observation
geometry.grasp: robot.is_grasping(jar) == IsGraspingState.TRUE (recorded enum == 1); current, not latched

goal.definition: 1 - tanh(d / 0.20 m), d = ||c - clamp(c, aabb_min, aabb_max)||
goal.goal_reference: goal sphere centre_world from the native GoalRegionChecker
goal.jar_goal_reference: closest point of the jar world AABB to the sphere centre

geometry.zeroing: Phi1 = 0 after a raw violation, after a closure-order failure and at every terminal state
geometry.information: Privileged training reward only; never an actor or critic input

heldout: held-out tasks are untouched: no job, input or audit uses them
